note: Kentucky State Parks campground on a wooded island in Lake Cumberland, reached by a causeway from Burnside. Paved back-in loops in the island's north end beside the 18-hole golf course, screened from the lake by woods; the 18 full-hookup sites (01-10, 12, 13, 53, 54, 58, 59, 64, 65) are in the centre. Two bathhouses, playground, boat ramp, and a marina next to the park; the park pool is closed until further notice. --Claude
